---
title: "05.Prepare_phyloseq"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

MetaPhlAn 4 (GTDB, species level, decontaminated) phyloseq object prepared for the analyses:

* sample names as in the rest of the project (`GPH_1`)
* only samples in `metadata.tsv`, with the processed metadata as sample data
* short taxa names (species) and clean ranks (no `d__`, `p__` prefixes)
* abundances kept as MetaPhlAn proportions of the total profile (the unclassified fraction is not included)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(here)
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Raw", "Metaphlan", "physeq_gtdb_species_decontam.rds"))
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ps
```

# Samples

```{r samples}
sample_names(ps) <- gsub("-", "_", sample_names(ps))

cat("Samples in phyloseq but not in metadata:", setdiff(sample_names(ps), metadata$sample_id), "\n")
cat("Samples in metadata but not in phyloseq:", setdiff(metadata$sample_id, sample_names(ps)), "\n")

ps <- prune_samples(metadata$sample_id, ps)

sample_metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(log10_depth = log10(reads)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(sample_metadata[sample_names(ps), ])
```

# Taxa

```{r taxa}
ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0, ps)

tax <- as(tax_table(ps), "matrix")[, c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")]
tax <- sub("^[a-z]__", "", tax)
colnames(tax) <- str_to_title(colnames(tax))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tax[, "Species"]))
taxa_names(ps) <- tax[, "Species"]
rownames(tax) <- tax[, "Species"]
tax_table(ps) <- tax_table(tax)

ps
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(ps, here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))
```
